opponent.label: Schezo Wegey
opponent.description:
Schezo Wegey is a major recurring character in Madou Monogatari and Puyo Puyo.
A dark mage who strives to be the strongest, and does so by any means necessary. While known to be a powerful magician, he's more known for his awfully euphemistic phrasing.
Don't call him a pervert or creeper. He really doesn't like that.

epilogue.hint: Complete a game where Schezo loses before you do.
epilogue.description: Schezo may have quickly took his leave, but the portal where he came from still lingers. This may be the one chance to get much closer to the dark mage...

costume.costume-description: The Dark Mage, but all dressed up in a formal coat. He was given this outfit as part of a gala on Pwurp Island, and he decided to put it on for a night of romance. Don't expect him to swing his sword around in this, though.
